summary: Comprehensive first-pass testing of Haulage AI (prompt 1 of 6). Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass covering /api health and /api/contact (create persistence, email/phone/consent/required-field validations, list w/o _id). Frontend: all 30 routes return 200 with unique titles and no console errors; theme toggle switches and persists via localStorage (haulage-theme=dark survives reload); status tag testids present on home (ai=4, approval=2, human=1); login (any creds) navigates to /app, role switcher is a shadcn combobox and switches heading (Ops Manager -> Dispatcher), logout clears session and redirects to /login, /app guard redirects unauthenticated users to /login; contact form shows all required-field errors on empty submit and transitions to the success state ('You are booked') with submitted summary + calendar placeholder + case-study/platform links on valid submission; Product dropdown reveals Overview + 7 modules; footer and mobile hamburger (nav-mobile-menu-btn) present. No critical bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to FastAPI lifespan context manager.
GET /api/contact returns up to 1000 submissions without auth/pagination; expected for the demo, but should be gated before production.

backend/.env has CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True which is invalid per CORS spec; browsers will reject credentialed requests. Not currently blocking because no credentialed calls are made, but worth fixing.
test_credentials: Demo login accepts any email/password (used demo@haulage.ai / demo1234).
seed_data_creation: Test contact rows created via POST /api/contact with TEST_ prefix (name 'TEST_User' / 'TEST User UI').
context_for_next_testing_agent: All data-testids match spec. Role switcher (app-role-switcher) and cf-role are shadcn Select combobox buttons — do NOT use select_option; click to open then click [role=option]. Status tag selectors: status-tag-ai/approval/human. Theme persistence key: localStorage['haulage-theme']. /app route is RequireAuth-guarded and redirects to /login.
